name: Multi-level DDA with Adaptive Mip Selection
definition: A traversal algorithm that uses a Distance Driven Algorithm (DDA) to step through a voxel grid, utilizing multiple mip levels of a majorant texture to balance step size and accuracy. It dynamically selects the mip level at each step to optimize performance without branching.
summary: Multi-level DDA with Adaptive Mip Selection is a branchless GPU volume rendering algorithm that optimizes sparse volume traversal by dynamically adjusting majorant texture resolution to balance step size and accuracy.
